baselineEvidence.placementAuthority: docs/design/SENSITIVE-HISTORY.md section 3; accepted by 0046 and amended by 0074
baselineEvidence.scope: Carried authority/source pointers, not a claim to have newly rechecked every older primary source.

windowBasis: [I] Candidate review envelope, not an incident trigger, publication date or proof of receipt. A named act still needs its own source/date. Inherited windows are byte-for-byte unchanged.

facets.recommendation: [I] The live decision window ends 6 August. Carry submitted Senate text with its institutional status; later war-policy proposals use their own topics.

agencyReasonNotes: [I] No class-required agency reason. Preserve named actors in reports; do not invent a derived mechanic or use absence of a reason as permission to target people.

triggerRules.policy: [I] Whole-word rules from triggerMatches; use the live proper-noun allowlist as well. A match requests review, never assigns a topic automatically. No gate:none approval is supplied.

topicRules: No adoption claim from a submission printing. It does not expressly say slavery; neither erase the implications nor insert an invented quotation.

examples.allowedOnlyAsWordingExample: Johnson submitted the resolution on 24 July.
examples.rejectExample: The submission proves both chambers adopted identical words.

remaining: House wording/adoption votes remain unresolved in S7; do not expand the July decision through November 1862.
proposedRuling: [I] Carry the reviewed baseline envelope; add S7 limits as review notes. Reject changed premises, hindsight and unapproved new wording.
